info.title: Launchpoint Buyer API
info.description: The API Launchpoint brands and agencies can use to manage their campaigns

tags.name: Campaigns
tags.description: Create and manage campaigns, review creators and content, and read performance data

get.description: Returns campaigns visible to the API key. Brand keys see their own campaigns; agency keys see campaigns of all brands they manage. Results are sorted by creation date, newest first.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. Repeat the parameter to match any of several statuses (e.g. `?status=active&status=paused`).

parameters.name: brand_id
parameters.description: Narrow results to a single brand. Agency keys only; must be a brand the agency manages.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Only campaigns created at or after this time (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Only campaigns created before this time (ISO 8601)

post.description: Creates a campaign in `draft` status. Drafts can be skeletal — tasks may be added later — but a campaign must have at least one active task before it can be published. Requires the `campaigns:write` scope. Agency keys must specify `brand_id`.

get.description: Returns a single campaign with its tasks embedded.

patch.description: Partially updates a campaign. Omitted fields are unchanged. `type` and `brand_id` are immutable and completed campaigns cannot be updated; everything else is editable in any other status — the same rules as the dashboard editor. Note that updating a `pending_approval` campaign withdraws the publish request and returns it to `draft`.

delete.description: Deletes a campaign that has never gone live. Only campaigns in `draft` or `pending_approval` status can be deleted; published campaigns should be completed instead.

post.description: Submits a draft campaign for review. Publishing is asynchronous: the campaign moves to `pending_approval` and becomes `active` once approved by Launchpoint (you'll receive a `campaign.status_changed` webhook, if configured). If the campaign is denied it returns to `draft` with `status_detail` explaining why. Fails with 422 if the campaign has no active tasks.

202.description: Publish request accepted; campaign is pending approval

post.description: Pauses an active campaign. Creators can no longer start work or submit content until the campaign is resumed. Pausing an already-paused campaign is a no-op and returns the unchanged campaign.

Resumes a paused campaign. Resuming an already-active campaign is a no-op and returns the unchanged campaign. A campaign that was auto-paused for a billing issue cannot be resumed until the issue is fixed in the dashboard.
Ends a campaign permanently. Outstanding work is settled. This is a terminal action — a completed campaign cannot be resumed or edited.
Adds a task (deliverable) to a campaign. API-created tasks use Launchpoint's standard creator compensation for the campaign; custom compensation is configured in the dashboard.

patch.description: Partially updates a task. Omitted fields are unchanged.

delete.description: Archives a task so no new creators can start it. Work already in progress is unaffected. Tasks are never hard-deleted; the archived task is returned with `status: "archived"`.

get.description: Returns the campaign's fulfillment products (items shipped or gifted to creators).

post.description: Adds a fulfillment product to the campaign.

get.description: Returns creators on the campaign with their application status, content pipeline counts, performance metrics, and spend.

post.description: Approves a creator's pending application to the campaign. Requires the `approvals:write` scope. Approving an already-approved creator is a no-op; reversing a rejection returns 409.
Rejects a creator's pending application to the campaign. Requires the `approvals:write` scope. Rejecting an already-rejected creator is a no-op; reversing an approval returns 409.

get.description: Returns content submitted by creators for review, newest first. Use `status=in_review` to fetch your review queue.

parameters.name: submitted_after
parameters.description: Only submissions submitted at or after this time (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: submitted_before
parameters.description: Only submissions submitted before this time (ISO 8601)

post.description: Approves submitted content, clearing the creator to post it. Requires the `approvals:write` scope. Approving commits the creator's compensation, so it cannot be undone. Approving an already-approved submission is a no-op; reversing a rejection returns 409.

Rejects submitted content and requests changes. Requires the `approvals:write` scope. Include `feedback` to tell the creator what to fix — it is delivered with the rejection. The creator may submit a revision, which returns the submission to `in_review` and increments `revision_count`.

get.description: Returns live published posts with their latest engagement metrics, newest first. Metrics are refreshed periodically; `metrics_updated_at` tells you how fresh they are.

parameters.name: posted_after
parameters.description: Only posts published at or after this time (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: posted_before
parameters.description: Only posts published before this time (ISO 8601)

get.description: Returns the campaign's report: creator funnel, content performance, and spend. Pass `group_by` to additionally break performance and spend down by task or platform.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Break metrics down by task or platform

patch.description: Partially updates a fulfillment product. Omitted fields are unchanged.

delete.description: Removes a fulfillment product from the campaign. Products already selected by creators cannot be removed (409).

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Number of items to return per page

StartingAfter.name: starting_after
StartingAfter.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A unique key (max 255 characters) to safely retry the request. Repeating a request with the same key within 24 hours returns the original response with an `Idempotent-Replay: true` header. Reusing a key with a different body returns 409.

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed — invalid JSON, unknown parameter value, or bad cursor (`invalid_request`)

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing, unknown, or revoked (`unauthenticated`)

Forbidden.description: The API key lacks a required scope (`missing_scope`) or referenced a brand it does not manage (`brand_not_managed`)

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible to this API key (`not_found`)

Conflict.description: The action conflicts with the resource's current state — e.g. `invalid_state_transition`, `field_locked_for_status`, `already_decided`, `already_reviewed`, or `idempotency_conflict`

ValidationFailed.description: The request is well-formed but semantically invalid (`validation_failed`) — the message names the offending field

CampaignStatus.description: Campaign lifecycle status. `draft` → `pending_approval` (submitted for Launchpoint review) → `active` ⇄ `paused` → `completed`. A denied publish returns the campaign to `draft` with `status_detail` populated.

CampaignStatusDetail.description: Why the campaign is in its current status. Null unless the campaign was auto-paused or a publish request was denied.

reason.description: For `auto_paused`: one of `billing_issue`, `other`. For `publish_denied`: the reviewer's explanation.

Format.description: The content format for a task

shopify_shop_domain.description: Your connected Shopify store domain, when fulfillment or codes run through Shopify

creator_approval_required.description: Whether creators must be approved before starting work

brand_approval_required.description: For agency-managed campaigns: whether the brand also signs off on content after the agency's review

post_approval_mode.description: How strictly content is reviewed before posting. `always` requires review of every submission.

product_seeding.description: Whether this is a product-seeding (gifting) campaign

description.description: What the campaign is about, shown to creators
description.example: Short-form UGC for our spring launch.

instructions.example: Film in daylight and show the product in the first 3 seconds.

brief_url.description: Link to an external full brief document

links.description: Links given to creators alongside the brief

spent_cents.description: Total paid to creators on this campaign, in cents. Read-only.

accepting_submissions.description: Whether new creators can currently start work. Controlled by pause/resume.

content_deadline_date.description: Date by which creators must submit content for review

post_deadline_date.description: Date by which approved content must be posted

tasks.description: The campaign's tasks. Embedded when fetching a single campaign; omitted in list responses (use `tasks_count`).

brand_id.description: The brand this campaign belongs to. Required for agency keys; optional for brand keys (must match the key's own brand if present).

content_deadline_date.description: Must be on or before post_deadline_date

tasks.description: Tasks to create with the campaign. Optional — drafts can be created without tasks, but at least one active task is required to publish.

products.description: Fulfillment products to create with the campaign

CampaignUpdate.description: Partial update — omitted fields are unchanged. Arrays (`video_examples`, `links`, `targeting`) are replaced wholesale. `type` and `brand_id` are immutable, and completed campaigns cannot be updated; everything else is editable in any other status, matching the dashboard. Updating a `pending_approval` campaign withdraws the publish request.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `starting_after` to fetch the next page. Null when there are no more results.

TaskStatus.description: `active` tasks accept new work; `archived` tasks accept no new creators; `closed` tasks are finished

Task.description: A deliverable creators complete for the campaign

instructions.example: Open the package on camera and show your first reaction.

requirements.description: Checklist items the content must satisfy

caption.description: Caption the creator must use when posting

require_ad_disclosure.description: Whether the post must carry the platform's paid-partnership / ad disclosure

tiktok_sound_url.description: TikTok sound the content must use

instagram_sound_url.description: Instagram sound the content must use

video_examples.description: URLs of example videos showing creators what to make

image_url.description: Cover image shown with the task

product_id.description: Limit this task to one of the campaign's products

review_mode.description: `media_review`: you review each submission. `autoreview`: submissions are approved automatically.

is_required.description: Whether every creator must complete this task. Only authored directly when the campaign's `settings.completion_mode` is `some_required`; other modes derive it.

display_order.description: Position of the task in the campaign's brief

FulfillmentProduct.description: A product shipped or gifted to creators as part of the campaign

fulfillment_type.description: How creators receive the product. `shopify`: ordered automatically from your connected store. `manual_ship`: you ship it yourself. `manual_redemption`: creators redeem a code or link. `manual`: handled outside Launchpoint.

is_gift.description: Whether the product is a gift on top of the campaign's main product

shopify_variant_id.description: The Shopify variant to order, for `shopify` fulfillment

CreatorStatus.description: The creator's application status on the campaign

ContentCounts.description: The creator's content pipeline on this campaign

CampaignCreator.description: A creator's participation in the campaign: application status, content pipeline, performance, and spend

decided_at.description: When the application was approved or rejected

spend_cents.description: Total paid to this creator on this campaign, in cents

SubmissionStatus.description: `in_review` submissions are waiting on your decision. Rejected submissions return to `in_review` when the creator submits a revision.

Submission.description: Content a creator submitted for review before posting

media_url.description: URL of the submitted video, or the first image of a carousel

revision_count.description: How many times the creator has revised this submission

feedback.description: The most recent rejection feedback sent to the creator, if any

Post.description: A live published post with its latest engagement metrics

submission_id.description: The approved submission this post was published from

metrics_updated_at.description: When the metrics were last refreshed

CampaignMetrics.description: The campaign report: pipeline health (funnel), content performance, and spend

effective_cpm_cents.description: spent_cents / views × 1000. Null until the campaign has views.

groups.description: Present when `group_by` is set: the same performance and spend blocks broken down per task or per platform

group_key.description: The task ID or platform name this row aggregates

group_label.description: Human-readable name — the task title or platform name

CampaignWebhookPayload.description: Sent when a campaign changes status — including publish approval, publish denial, and auto-pauses

SubmissionWebhookPayload.description: Sent when a creator submits content for review (including revisions) or a submission is decided

PostWebhookPayload.description: Sent when a creator's approved content goes live, and when a live post's metrics are refreshed

message.description: Human-readable explanation, naming the offending field where applicable

feedback.description: Feedback delivered to the creator — tells them what to fix before resubmitting.
feedback.example: Great energy! Please reshoot with the product visible in the first 3 seconds.

Visibility.description: `public` campaigns appear in creator discovery; `unlisted` campaigns are reachable only via an access code or direct link

CompletionMode.description: How creators engage with the campaign's tasks. `all_required`: every task must be completed. `pick_one`: the creator commits to exactly one task. `all_optional`: any subset. `some_required`: each task's own `is_required` flag decides.

CampaignLink.description: A link given to creators alongside the brief (store page, app listing, affiliate link, ...)

service.description: What the link points at, e.g. `shopify`, `appstore`, `playstore`

description.example: Product page to link in bio

property.description: The creator property to match on. Valid properties are listed in the dashboard's targeting editor.

operator.description: How conditions within this group combine

Targeting.description: Which creators can join the campaign. Groups combine via `root_operator`; conditions within a group combine via the group's `operator`. Null means no targeting (open to all).

fulfillment_type.description: How creators receive the product. `shopify`: ordered automatically from your connected store. `manual_ship`: you ship it yourself. `manual_redemption`: creators redeem a code or link. `manual`: handled outside Launchpoint.

is_gift.description: Whether the product is a gift on top of the campaign's main product

shopify_variant_id.description: The Shopify variant to order, for `shopify` fulfillment
